recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized vector portrait of a musician playing an instrument, encased in multiple concentric, vibrantly colored rainbow outlines that radiate outward. The background features a dark field with a geometric sunburst and a star-patterned section, all rendered in flat, saturated color blocks with no gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric rainbow outlines echoing the subject's silhouette
High-contrast facial features against a dark, solid background
Diagonal sunburst rays contrasting with curved rainbow arcs
Flat color planes defining volume and shadow
coreInvariants: Solid black or deep navy background for maximum color pop
Stylized, simplified facial features with distinct shadow shapes
Integration of a musical instrument as a primary compositional element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left, cropped at the waist, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and sunglasses, framed by the tightest rainbow contour.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the face, down the rainbow contours to the hands/instrument, then up to the top-right text area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the upper right and lower left to balance the dense color work.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown provide the structural base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange, yellow, and red create the primary 'glow' effect.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Purple and blue provide cool-toned transitions in the rainbow bands.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the contours against very low-value dark backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Groovy, high-contrast sans-serif with rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Exaggerated, bulbous curves on letters like 'C', 'S', and 'R'
Tight letter spacing with slight baseline bounce
Uniform white fill with no outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase-style 'n' and 'a' scaled to match uppercase height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face paired with minimal, small-scale geometric sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic curve and weight.
Similar rounded terminals and lack of descenders.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat vector illustration of a soul singer with sunglasses playing a guitar. Surround the figure with 5-7 concentric rainbow-colored outlines (red, orange, yellow, purple, blue). The background should be black with a diagonal grey sunburst on the left and a small star-patterned panel on the right. Use flat color blocks for shading on the face and clothes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, white, psychedelic-style display text in the top right corner. The text should have rounded, bulbous shapes and high contrast between thick and thin strokes. Add small technical metadata text in a clean sans-serif in the corners.

verificationChecks: Are there at least 5 distinct rainbow contour lines?
Is the text white and right-aligned?
Are all colors flat with no gradients?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the background sunburst rays
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, non-blurry edges on the rainbow bands.
Ensure the text does not touch the subject's head.
Verify the star pattern is contained within its own geometric block.
Confirm the high-contrast shadow shapes on the face are preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vector Portrait + Concentric Rainbow Contours + Flat Color Shading + Psychedelic Display Type + Black Background
